// CASE braceless_if_return expect=pass
async function e1(n) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (await isFree(i)) return i;
  return -1;
}

// CASE braceless_if_break expect=pass
async function e2(n) {
  let found = -1;
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (await isFree(i)) { found = i; break; }
  return found;
}

// CASE braced_if_return_control expect=pass
async function e3(n) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    if (await isFree(i)) return i;
  }
  return -1;
}

// CASE braceless_for_of_if_return expect=pass
async function e4(ids) {
  for (const id of ids) if (await isFree(id)) return id;
  return null;
}

// CASE braceless_if_throw expect=pass
async function e5(n) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) if (await isBad(i)) throw new Error("bad");
}

// CASE braceless_sleep expect=pass
async function e6(n) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) await sleep(100);
}

// CASE braced_sleep_poll_control expect=pass
async function e7(n) {
  for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
    if (await ready()) return true;
    await sleep(100);
  }
  return false;
}

// CASE braceless_try_return expect=pass
async function e8(urls) {
  for (let i = 0; i < urls.length; i++) try { return await fetchOne(urls[i]); } catch (e) { last = e; }
  throw last;
}

// CASE braced_try_return_control expect=pass
async function e9(urls) {
  let last;
  for (let i = 0; i < urls.length; i++) {
    try {
      return await fetchOne(urls[i]);
    } catch (e) {
      last = e;
    }
  }
  throw last;
}
